phrase.zh: 找到一条记录，不必翻遍所有页。
phrase.en: Find a record without reading every page.

visual.zh: 一排排档案卡被细线和标记连接，借图书检索的形象表达数据索引。卡片位置不代表真实数据库的物理布局。
visual.en: Rows of cards link through lines and markers, borrowing a library-search image for a database index. Card positions do not represent a real database layout.

background.zh: 数据库索引按选定的键组织查找入口，可让适合的查询更快找到行。索引也占用空间，并在数据变化时产生维护成本，所以并非越多越好。
background.en: A database index organizes lookup entries for selected keys and can speed suitable queries. It also uses storage and requires upkeep when data changes, so more indexes are not always better.
